featuresPage.heroTitle: Built for people serious about marriage
featuresPage.heroSubtitle: Every feature exists for one reason — to help you find a genuine, lasting match, safely and on your own terms.
featuresPage.leadIn: From the moment you sign up to the day you introduce your match to your family, every part of Biye Kori is built to earn your trust — not just your attention.
featuresPage.section1Title: Real people, reviewed by real humans
featuresPage.section1Body: Fake profiles ruin matrimony platforms. That's why every profile on Biye Kori is phone-verified and manually reviewed before anyone can see it.
featuresPage.f1Body: Every account starts with a 6-digit code sent to a real phone number — no email-only sign-ups, no bots.
featuresPage.f2Body: Our team checks every new profile — photos, details, and intent — before it ever goes live.
featuresPage.f3Title: A verified badge you can trust
featuresPage.f3Body: The verified badge tells you a profile's identity and details have already been checked by our team.
featuresPage.section2Body: Searching for marriage is personal. Biye Kori gives you fine-grained control instead of exposing everything to everyone.
featuresPage.f4Body: Your contact details stay hidden until you choose to connect with someone. Nothing leaves your profile without your say-so.
featuresPage.f5Body: People who've liked you stay blurred in your list until you decide to view and unlock their full profile.
featuresPage.f6Body: Uncomfortable with someone? Block or report them instantly — our team reviews every report.
featuresPage.section3Title: Find someone close enough to actually meet
featuresPage.section3Body: Matches that live far away rarely turn into marriages. We surface people near you first and always show exactly how far away they are.
featuresPage.f7Body: Matches from your own district and nearby upazilas appear first — proximity matters for real families.
featuresPage.f8Body: Every profile shows how far away they are, so you and your family always know what you're deciding on.
featuresPage.f9Body: Narrow results by religion, profession, education, and marital status to find genuinely compatible matches faster.
featuresPage.section4Title: Pay only for what you actually use
featuresPage.section4Body: No pushy subscriptions. Top up your wallet with bKash or Nagad and spend it only on unlocking the profiles you're genuinely interested in.
featuresPage.f10Body: Add balance in seconds using the payment methods you already trust.
featuresPage.f11Body: Browsing, liking, and getting liked are always free — you only spend from your wallet to unlock a full profile.
featuresPage.f12Body: Every top-up and spend is logged in your wallet, so you always know where your balance went.
featuresPage.section5Title: Bangla and English, family values built in
featuresPage.section5Body: From the language you browse in to the details we surface, Biye Kori is designed around how Bangladeshi families actually search for marriage.
featuresPage.f13Body: Switch between Bangla and English any time — the whole app is translated, not just a few labels.
featuresPage.f14Body: From Dhaka to the smallest upazila, Biye Kori covers every district in Bangladesh.
featuresPage.f15Body: Profession, education, religion, and marital status sit front and center on every profile.
featuresPage.ctaBody: Creating a profile and browsing nearby matches costs nothing. Join in minutes.

howItWorksPage.heroTitle: From sign-up to a real relationship
howItWorksPage.heroSubtitle: Five clear steps, so you and your family always know what happens next.
howItWorksPage.leadIn: No confusing steps, no hidden fees, and no unverified strangers — just a clear path from creating your profile to building something real.
howItWorksPage.step1Body: Sign up with your phone number and verify it with a 6-digit code. Add your photos, profession, education, and what you're looking for in a partner.
howItWorksPage.step1Tip: Profiles with a clear photo and complete details get noticed faster.
howItWorksPage.step2Body: Before your profile goes live, our team checks it by hand — so every profile you see later has passed the same review.
howItWorksPage.step2Tip: Most profiles are reviewed within 24 hours.
howItWorksPage.step3Body: Browse verified profiles starting with your own district, and filter by religion, profession, education, or marital status.
howItWorksPage.step3Tip: Use a Super Like to stand out when you're especially interested.
howItWorksPage.step4Body: When someone you liked likes you back, it's a match. Unlock their full profile from your wallet and start chatting safely, inside the app.
howItWorksPage.step4Tip: Nothing about your contact details is shared until you choose to.
howItWorksPage.step5Title: Involve your family, at your pace
howItWorksPage.step5Body: Loop in your family whenever you're ready — share the profile, talk through the details together, and take the next step toward marriage on your own timeline.
howItWorksPage.step5Tip: You stay in control of what's shared and when.
howItWorksPage.q1Q: How long does profile review take?
howItWorksPage.q1A: Most profiles are reviewed within 24 hours. You'll be notified as soon as yours is approved and visible to others.
howItWorksPage.q2Q: What happens if my profile is rejected?
howItWorksPage.q2A: You'll see the reason directly in Settings, and can update your details and resubmit for review.
howItWorksPage.q3Q: Can I edit my profile after it's approved?
howItWorksPage.q3A: Yes — any changes you save go through a quick re-review before they're visible to others again, so profile details always stay accurate.
howItWorksPage.ctaBody: Setting up your profile takes about five minutes.

assistantService.heroSubtitle: A personalized matchmaking service by Biye Kori
assistantService.formSubtitle: Add your contact info and our team will reach out
assistantService.formSuccess: Thanks! Our team will contact you shortly.
assistantService.formError: Could not submit your request. Please try again.
assistantService.step1Body: A personal advisor is assigned to you to understand your expectations and preferences.
assistantService.step2Body: Your personal advisor will create or update your profile and photos following best practice.
assistantService.step3Body: Your advisor will find matching profiles for you and send them to you on a weekly basis.
assistantService.step4Body: Based on mutual interest of both parties, your personal advisor will arrange a meeting at a convenient time and location.
assistantService.faq1Q: What is the benefit of the assistant service?
assistantService.faq1A: A dedicated advisor is assigned to you. They first learn your detailed requirements, then search for suitable profiles and send them to you weekly. Based on your choice, your advisor communicates with the other party and, on mutual agreement, arranges a meeting. They also manage your profile and photos for you.
assistantService.faq2Q: How will I interact with my advisor?
assistantService.faq2A: Your advisor reaches out by phone and keeps you updated with matches on a weekly basis, or as you prefer.
assistantService.faq3Q: How does assistant service differ from other packages?
assistantService.faq3A: Regular packages are self-service — you browse and manage everything yourself. With the assistant service, a dedicated advisor handles your profile, matches, and meeting arrangements for you.
assistantService.faq4Q: How many calls or meetings will be arranged during my membership?
assistantService.faq4A: This depends on your plan and mutual interest with matches — your advisor will keep you informed throughout your membership period.
assistantService.faq5Q: Can I hide my profile from public search?
assistantService.faq5A: Yes — ask your advisor to set your profile to private, and it will only be shared with the matches they hand-pick for you.
assistantService.faq6Q: How can I buy the assistant service package?
assistantService.faq6A: Submit your contact info above and our team will reach out to guide you through the plans and payment.

faqPage.heroSubtitle: Everything you need to know before and after you join. Can't find your answer? Reach out any time.
faqPage.leadIn: From signing up to paying safely, here's everything members ask us most — organized by topic so you can find your answer fast.
faqPage.cat1q1Q: Is Biye Kori free to join?
faqPage.cat1q1A: Yes. Creating a profile, verifying your phone number, and browsing nearby matches is completely free. A small wallet balance is only needed to unlock the full profile of someone who's liked you.
faqPage.cat1q2Q: What do I need to create a profile?
faqPage.cat1q2A: Just your phone number to start. You'll then add your name, date of birth, district, and at least one clear photo before submitting for review.
faqPage.cat1q3A: About five minutes for the initial profile. Full review by our team usually finishes within 24 hours.
faqPage.cat2q1A: Every account starts with phone number verification through a one-time code. After that, our team manually reviews each profile before it becomes visible to others.
faqPage.cat2q2Q: What does the verified badge mean?
faqPage.cat2q2A: It means that profile's identity and details have already passed our team's manual review.
faqPage.cat2q3Q: Can a profile lose its verified status?
faqPage.cat2q3A: Yes — if a profile is edited, it goes back through review before those changes are visible to others again.
faqPage.cat3q1A: Yes. You control who can see your full profile and photos. We never share your contact details without your permission.
faqPage.cat3q2Q: Who can see my photos before I unlock a match?
faqPage.cat3q2A: People who like you see a blurred version of your profile until you choose to view and unlock theirs in return.
faqPage.cat3q3Q: Can I block or report someone?
faqPage.cat3q3A: Yes, in one tap from their profile or your conversation. Our team reviews every report we receive.
faqPage.cat4q1Q: Does Biye Kori cover my district?
faqPage.cat4q1A: We support all 64 districts of Bangladesh, and show you how far away a match is so you can decide what's comfortable for you and your family.
faqPage.cat4q2Q: Can I use the app in Bangla?
faqPage.cat4q2A: Yes — tap the language switch at the top of any page to move between Bangla and English at any time.
faqPage.cat4q3A: A Super Like tells someone you're especially interested — it puts your profile in front of them right away.
faqPage.cat5q1Q: How do I top up my wallet?
faqPage.cat5q1A: Go to Settings → Wallet, choose an amount, and pay with bKash or Nagad. Your balance updates immediately.
faqPage.cat5q2Q: What do I actually pay for?
faqPage.cat5q2A: Only for unlocking a full profile of someone who's liked you. Browsing, liking, and matching are always free.
faqPage.cat5q3Q: Is payment through bKash and Nagad secure?
faqPage.cat5q3A: Yes — top-ups run through bKash's and Nagad's official checkout, so your payment details never touch our servers.
faqPage.ctaBody: Create a free profile and explore — or reach out and our team will help.
